Currently lead developer of the Planning/eBudgeting module of ePlanning at the Secretariat General of the Indonesian House of Representatives (DPR RI), owning the full budgeting lifecycle, Keycloak single sign-on, and integrations with six government APIs. Proficient across the full stack — from Laravel and Python/FastAPI backends to Next.js frontends, Kubernetes delivery, and Linux server management.

sample_faq.q: Tech stack yang sering dipakai apa?
sample_faq.a: Umumnya PHP/Laravel dan Python (FastAPI/Flask) di backend, Next.js/Blade + Tailwind di frontend, MySQL/PostgreSQL/Redis untuk data, serta Docker & Kubernetes untuk deployment.
